full_judgment:
3. Mr. Md. Aftab Hossain, learned Advocate-on-Record appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that the Administrative Tribunal as well as the Administrative Appellate Tribunal committed illegality in holding that the proceeding was barred under Rule 39(8) of Rajshahi Krishi Unnayan Bank Karmachari Chakuri Probidhanmala 1988. He submits that 180 days time limit as provided in this Probidhanmala has been withdrawn by order dated 24.9.1991 of the Establishment Division. So it can-not be found that the case is barred by limitation. 

 4. We have gone through the judgment of the Administrative Tribunal wherein it has been found that 717 days was consumed for the disposal of the proceeding though time limit was 180 days. This proceeding ended on 13.10.1991 and the time limit that was there in the rule was with-drawn with effect from 3.2.1992 and from this the Administrative Tribunal found that there was no wrong in the judgment of the Tribunal in holding that the case is barred by limitation. We have considered the judgment of both the Tribunals and also the admitted position that there was approval of amendment of the rule on 3.2.1992 which has no retrospective effect and thereby it appears that the case is barred by limitation. From the perusal of the judgment we hold that no illegality and wrong has been committed by both the Tribunals and there is nothing to interfere with the same.
